title: Notable neighbor probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let a long-code table and a real parameter $\\varepsilon$ be given, and fix a vertex $v$ and coordinate $i\\in[q]$. The notable neighbor probability is the probability, for a uniformly chosen neighbor $w$ of $v$, that the coordinate obtained by applying the inverse edge permutation to $i$ is notable at $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A long-code table on the vertices of $G$
caveat: The supplied statement does not define notable coordinates or explicitly state the neighbor sampling law.
